articles.summary: HILLSBORO, Ore. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 14, 2026-- Lattice Semiconductor (NASDAQ: LSCC), the low power programmable and platform firmware leader, today announced its exhibition plan for the upcoming AutoSens Europe 2026, taking place on Sept. 22 – 24, 2026, in Barcelona, Spain.
articles.title: Lattice to Showcase Next Gen Automotive Sensing Innovations at AutoSens Europe 2026
